notes: Shopify store (myborosil.com). Tier: HTTP-first only (curl) - fully sufficient, no Playwright/Chrome needed. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only bot-agent-specific rules for admin/cart/search paths); Sitemap: https://myborosil.com/sitemap.xml. Pulled the full sitemap index, then sitemap_collections_1.xml (~350 collection URLs), sitemap_pages_1.xml, and sitemap_metaobject_pages_1.xml, and grepped case-insensitively for diwali/holi/easter/halloween/eid/thanksgiving/mother/rakhi/raksha/christmas/valentine/father/new-year across all collection URLs and titles. For every holiday-named collection found, fetched the rendered PLP HTML (title/h1) and the Shopify /products.json?limit=250 endpoint (with pagination checks) to get true enumerated product counts and sample product titles, since Shopify products_count/PLP badges are known to be unreliable. DIWALI (checked thoroughly per instructions, given India glassware/kitchenware retailer): no dedicated 'Diwali Gifting' PLP exists. Only 'diwali-sale' collection found (250+ products across 46 paginated pages, generic catalog items incl. spare lids/gaskets/random bottles with zero Diwali theming in titles) - this is a storewide sale/clearance dump, excluded per rules. Checked all diya/diffuser product-type collections (diyas, diya-diffusers, akhand-diyas, diya-lights-diffusers, silver-akhand-diyas, diffuser) - diyas collection description explicitly says 'Whether it is Diwali or everyday home interiors' and 'A perfect companion to Diwali and wedding puja' - i.e. the site itself frames these as generic year-round pooja/decor product-type categories, not Diwali-exclusive gifting PLPs, so excluded as normal categories that merely contain some Diwali-relevant products. Also checked /pages/diwali-silver-rush - this is a generic sitewide collection-index/menu landing page (links to ~140 unrelated collections spanning the whole catalog), not a genuine PLP - excluded. CHRISTMAS: only 'christmas-sale' exists (100 products, generic bottles/lunchboxes/mugs, zero Christmas theming) - storewide sale, excluded. No dedicated Christmas gifting PLP found. NEW YEAR: only 'new-year-sale' (250+ capped, generic sale) - excluded. HOLI, EASTER, HALLOWEEN, EID, THANKSGIVING: zero matches anywhere in collections/pages sitemaps - genuinely absent. RAKSHA BANDHAN: 'rakhi-gifting' (59 products, full enumeration confirmed via products.json page 2 = 0) is a genuine curated gifting PLP - real product grid of dinner sets, mugs, jars, kettles, tumblers marketed as rakhi gifts; included. 'rakhi-1' is a dead/empty duplicate collection (0 products) - excluded. VALENTINE'S DAY: 'valentine-day' (13 products, confirmed via products.json) is genuinely curated with Valentine-branded product titles ('Larah Valentine Day Mug Set', 'Larah Valentine Day Forever Opalware Mug', 'Larah Valentine Day Love Opalware Mug', 'His and Hers Mug Set') - included. FATHER'S DAY (evaluated under the same genuine-PLP test as any other holiday per instructions, not excluded merely for being a universal gift occasion): 'fathers-day' and 'fathers-day-1' (both titled 'Fathers Day'/'Father's Day') were checked via full products.json pagination and total 536 products each (250+250+36), sampled titles show random unthemed catalog items including spare gaskets, vent valves, and lunchboxes in arbitrary colors with zero Father's Day framing - this is essentially the whole/generic catalog auto-tagged into a broad marketing collection, not a curated gift edit, so it FAILS the genuine-PLP/curation test and is excluded on that basis (not on the 'universal occasion' basis). 'fathers-day-sale' (250+ capped) is additionally a sale page - excluded. MOTHER'S DAY: no dedicated 'Mother's Day' named collection exists on the site at all (thoroughly checked - absent). The closest collections are 'gifts-for-mom' (46 products) and 'moms-approved' (39 products), which are generic evergreen recipient-persona collections (same family as for-her/for-him/for-family/friends/for-couples/birthday-special/housewarming-gifts), not dated/named as a Mother's Day event by the site's own taxonomy, even though a couple of individual product titles inside mention 'Mother's Day Special' - excluded as normal gift-recipient categories, not genuine seasonal/holiday PLPs. OTHER SALE/EVENT PAGES EXCLUDED (storewide sale/clearance, not genuine holiday categories): independence-day-sale, black-friday-sale, black-friday-sale-larah, monsoon-sale, winter-sale, summer-collection, end-of-year-sale, eoys1, flash-sale, flash-sales, employees-sale, borosil-sale, borosil-sale-larah, the-50-off-store, half-price-hours. Independence Day is also outside the defined holiday scope for this project. No Thanksgiving/Halloween/Easter/Holi/Eid presence anywhere confirmed via sitemap-wide keyword sweep. Final valid rows: Valentine's Day (13, exact enumeration) and Raksha Bandhan/Rakhi Gifting (59, exact enumeration via pagination check).
